name: AppLovin Corporation
moat_justification: AXON + MAX data flywheel and integration switching costs, but inputs are bought not owned, the model lead is re-earned quarterly, Unity Vector is closing, and platform privacy rules are a hostage risk.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 2.7%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (estimate: Higher of the last tagged FY2024 capex ($4.8M, FY24 10-K) and the v4 TTM estimate (~$19M), per Andrew's conservative rule (2026-10-13)); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 10.94 vs 3-yr median 4.96 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 6.1x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Elite owner's-earnings machine, moat 6/10 — clears 15% on current TTM numbers (18.4% weighted, IV $376 vs $272) but the verdict is assumption-dominated (methods span C to A); size it like a B, not an A.
moat_for: AXON model plus the data flywheel from MAX mediation's installed publisher base
Deep integrations and real switching friction for publishers and advertisers
Proven pricing power — net revenue per install compounding
Asset-light cost structure rivals can't easily undercut
moat_against: Raw inputs (publisher supply, training data) are bought, not owned
Model lead must be re-earned every quarter (Q2 2026 showed a model-timing slip)
Unity Vector is growing fast off the same supply

overrides.source: Higher of the last tagged FY2024 capex ($4.8M, FY24 10-K) and the v4 TTM estimate (~$19M), per Andrew's conservative rule (2026-10-13)
